checks.name: No duplicate game id and no team listed twice on the same date
Each fresh score's official game link is away-vs-home with the same game id
Published team +/- does not sum to zero
checks.actual: sum of the 30 published +/- values = -5.3; mean PTS 113.44 vs mean implied points allowed 113.62 (difference -0.18). Because every game awards the same points to both sides the true sum is 0. Consistent with one-decimal rounding, but larger than the +/-1.5 bound that pure rounding allows, so it is reported, not corrected, and the column is not used as a model input (flag F-PLUSMINUS). Spot check: the Chicago team page independently shows -18.0, and its own OPPG header (129.6) gives 111.6 - 129.6 = -18.0, so that row is faithful to the official source and the league-wide discrepancy is not explained by this transcription.

checks.name: Within the inherited 2026-11-02 snapshot, standings and team stats agree on W-L
The 56 inherited game rows were not individually re-fetched
checks.actual: They carry their own official source URL and game link, and check C05/C06 corroborates them league-wide and date-by-date, but no row-by-row re-fetch was performed (flag F-INHERITED).

checks.name: The official games page renders an odds toggle but no odds values in the fetched text
checks.actual: The page shows 'HIDE ODDS'; no price values were present in the retrieved page text, so no price was transcribed. Whether those prices are official NBA data or a partner feed is not established here; they are treated as unavailable and no ROI is computed (flag F-PRICE).
